sections.title: Look Back (Review)
paragraphs: Pray for one another.
Read

The Bible teaches that after many years of silence; God spoke and sent the angel of the Lord to a virgin girl named Mary. Mary was a descendent of Abraham and King David. The angel told Mary that although she had never been with a man, she would give birth to a son who would be conceived by the Holy Spirit. He would be Christ the Savior whom people had been waiting for many years. His mission would be to save people from their sins.

sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read
After Jesus was born, He grew in favor with both God and man. When Jesus was about 30 years old, He began to teach and do great miracles among the people.

One time as Jesus and His followers were crossing a lake in a boat. Jesus fell asleep in the boat and a storm came up. His followers were afraid and began to wake up Jesus. Speaking to the wind and the waves, Jesus commanded them to stop — and they stopped! His followers were amazed and began to say that even nature obeyed His command.
Read
Let’s read some verses from the Holy Scriptures, the Bible, that relate to this story.
Mark 4:35 to 5:20
Read

These verses teach us that God's grace sets us free. Jesus freed a man from demons whom no one else could set free — not because the man was worthy, but because Jesus is gracious. Jesus has power over fear and storms, over darkness and evil spirits, and even over death itself! Jesus offers this freedom and peace to all who trust in Him.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little — how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Do
What kind of spiritual bondage is your family in? Let’s ask Jesus to set us free and thank him for the freedom that he gives us!
Ask
I hope you enjoyed this story. When can we meet again?
Do you think someone else should hear this story?
